componenten-heading.name: Heading
componenten-heading.description: A heading. The level (`h1` to `h4`) is separate from the style, so a card title can be an `h2` that looks like Kop 3.

componenten-button.name: Button
componenten-button.description:
A button. Its text says what it does ("Versturen"), also on its own. button.css gives it its look; the filled button
has no class of its own, the soft one has `hf-button-soft`.

reactComponentMeta.description:
A button. Its text says what it does ("Versturen"), also on its own. button.css gives it its look; the filled button
has no class of its own, the soft one has `hf-button-soft`.

appearance.name: appearance
appearance.description: `default` is the filled button, for the main action. `soft` is quieter, for an action next to the main one.

type.name: type
type.description: What the button does. It is required: a button in a form sends the form unless it says otherwise.
